summary: YY Group filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its $20 million at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program, under which it issued 93,880,252 Class A ordinary shares at market prices over time, with a 3.75% sales agent commission. The filing updates prior disclosures and confirms the program is concluded with no further sales. The net proceeds of ~$19.1 million will be used to retire acquisition-related payments and for working capital. This is a routine capital-raising update, not a special-situation event such as a going-private, tender offer, or activist campaign.
